samir: FYI starting an access & KMS sanity sweep for the payments namespace. spotted RBAC churn last night and a few KMS audit gaps. want a clean evidence baseline before any entitlement reduction.
leah.eng: noted. which KMS key? saw noisy alerts but not sure if it's the payments-keyring or a cross-account grant.
oscar-sre: it's payments-key in eu-west-1 plus one cross-account grant that looks odd — partner acct-9812. alert id: KMS_AUDIT_GAP_1271
samir: jamal, can you snapshot current admin principals + export KMS grants? immutable evidence only (no manual edits).
jamal-sec: on it. I'll run both the IAM snapshot and the KMS grant export, upload to secure-s3 and post hash. commands I plan to use:
```bash
# IAM snapshot (GCP)
gcloud projects get-iam-policy $PROJECT --format=json > /tmp/payments-iam.json
# KMS grants export
gcloud kms keys get-iam-policy payments-key --location=europe-west1 --format=json > /tmp/payments-key-iam.json
``` 
clara-ops: I'll pause any automated entitlement sweeps for payments until you post candidate lists. we shouldn't prune during an ingestion investigation.
auditbot: automated note - evidence bucket reserved: s3://redwood-audit/evidence/3732108888/ (write lock enabled)
leah.eng: also run `tools/priv-check --env=payments --format=csv` and add a column for "owner-contact". any ownerless grants should be flagged as "hold:investigate".
oscar-sre: pulling logs for 96h window to check reingestion possibility. if forwarder restarted and ACKed later we might backfill; if not, we need to treat missing events as unknown.
jamal-sec: snapshot uploaded. s3://redwood-audit/evidence/3732108888/snapshot.json sha256:a1f9... :white_check_mark:
samir: good. next steps:
- oscar validate ingestion/backfill possibility and update INFRA ticket INFRA-8132
- jamal + leah run least-priv and produce candidate prune CSV with blast-radius and revert commands
- no ad-hoc prunes; schedule a 30m canary window with 1h rollback watch
- attach everything to SEC-2026-6212 and link emergency-grant playbook
leah.eng: created SEC-2026-6212, attached snapshot and playbook: https://rbw-docs/internal/sec/emergency-grant.md
oscar-sre: traced gap to a forwarder pod OOM during a rollout; about ~120 messages unacked. INFRA-8132 updated. reingest tested but some payloads missing fields so can't reliably backfill.
jamal-sec: least-priv run in progress. ETA 4h. I'll include explicit revert commands and a per-item risk tag.
clara-ops: scheduling canary tomorrow 09:00 PT. inviting #eng-oncall, #payments, #eng-sre, #security. ops will be on standby for rollback.
samir: thanks. if any grant is ownerless and used in production, mark as don't prune and escalate to me. keep all artifacts in SEC-2026-6212.
